visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male presenter with short, salt-and-pepper hair and rimless glasses is framed in a medium shot. He is wearing a plain black button-down shirt. Behind him is a digital backdrop of a night cityscape featuring the illuminated Taipei 101 skyscraper and various urban lights under a dark sky. He gestures frequently with both hands, using palms-up motions and finger points to emphasize his spoken points while maintaining direct eye contact. (2) The visual transitions to a high-contrast cinematic animation of a black hole in deep space. It features a glowing, white-hot center surrounded by a swirling, intensely bright orange and yellow accretion disk that seems to spin rapidly. Small points of light representing distant stars are scattered throughout the dark background, and the overall lighting is dramatic and centralized around the event horizon. (3) The scene cuts back to the presenter in the same studio setting. He continues his animated delivery, nodding his head and raising his eyebrows for emphasis. His hands remain active in the lower half of the frame, occasionally coming together or pointing toward the camera. Large white subtitles with a thin black outline are positioned at the bottom center of the frame. (4) An informational diagram is displayed, occupying the center of the frame. It shows a complex mechanical assembly with purple energy swirls contained within a transparent spherical housing, surrounded by several metallic coils and wires. Black rectangular labels marked P1, P2, and P3 are connected to specific parts of the device by thin red lines, set against a clean white background. (5) In the final phase, the presenter points both index fingers downwards toward the bottom of the screen with a wide, friendly smile. A blue graphic banner with the channel's name in white text remains at the top left corner, and additional variety-style text overlays appear briefly to encourage viewer interaction and comments.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Variety]: 驚！科. [Subtitle]: 科學家做出了黑洞炸彈. (2) [Subtitle]: 而且是在地球上. (3) [Subtitle]: 最近英國與義大利的科學家們真的模擬出一個黑洞炸彈的模型. (4) [Subtitle]: 驗證了50多年前提出的一種可能的物理效應. (5) [Subtitle]: 黑洞超輻射. [Logo]: source: cirone-Musi, Festival della Scienza. (6) [Subtitle]: 想像黑洞快速旋轉 如果我們丟些能量波. (7) [Subtitle]: 像是光波過去 這些波不但沒被黑洞吃掉. (8) [Subtitle]: 反而能夠偷到黑洞的旋轉力氣 然後變得更強彈出來. (9) [Subtitle]: 如果在黑洞旁邊有個鏡子 不斷把這些變強的波反彈回去. (10) [Subtitle]: 他們就會一次一次的偷能量變得更強. (11) [Subtitle]: 最後能量大到像炸彈一樣爆發出來. (12) [Subtitle]: 那科學家怎麼在實驗室玩真的呢. (13) [Subtitle]: 他們並沒有從外太空進口黑洞. (14) [Subtitle]: 避免了關稅. (15) [Subtitle]: 他們是用我們比較熟悉的電與磁的原理來模仿. (16) [Subtitle]: 主角是一個會快速旋轉的鋁柱. (17) [Subtitle]: 充當迷你版的旋轉黑洞. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後科學家把它放進一個特製共振腔裡. (19) [Subtitle]: 把極微弱的電磁波困在裡面. (20) [Subtitle]: 藉由反射 困在那個空間裡不斷繞不斷吸能量. (21) [Subtitle]: 以指數級暴增. (22) [Subtitle]: 哇 結果就像一個小型的電磁炸彈. (23) [Subtitle]: 或是一對感情不好的伴侶. (24) [Subtitle]: 雖然這研究跟真黑洞的量級差很多. (25) [Subtitle]: 但作為研究天體噴流或黑洞能量抽取的教具非常適合. (26) [Subtitle]: 那這會變成新型武器嗎 應該不會. (27) [Subtitle]: 因為如果你有黑洞 你還需要什麼武器. (28) [Slogan]: 快留言許願下週《泛科學NEWS》就來報！
